item.title: From metros to soundboxes: how Paytunes is building India’s audio ad network
item.description: India’s audio advertising market is entering a new phase of growth. The segment is expected to reach Rs 2,610 crore in 2026, growing at 1.5%, according to WPP’s This Year Next Year (TYNY) report (December 2025). While still smaller than video and display, audio is steadily gaining ground as consumption shifts toward on-demand, choice-based listening. item.title: At 25, ICICI Lombard bets on prevention over payouts
item.description: In an industry traditionally defined by hospital bills and repair estimates, ICICI Lombard is trying to flip the script. item.description: Shankar Gaur has taken on the role of Quick Commerce lead at Reckitt India. Gaur has been with Reckitt for nearly eight years, holding roles across brand and sales functions.
